evidence.name: Screen field: Show a restore-purchases link
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Show a restore-purchases link" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Show a restore-purchases link
sections.description: Adds a small 'Restore Purchases' control in the header so returning buyers can recover an existing subscription instead of paying twice. Keep it on: a working restore option is effectively required on app-store paywalls and it reassures buyers, which protects conversions. There's also a Restore link available in the footer legal links, so use whichever placement fits your layout.
